description: This file contains utility functions to handle combobox interactions, specifically managing 'Other' choices, enabling and disabling related input fields, and validating user selections.

methods.name: other_choice
methods.description: Checks if the selected option in the drop-down menu has the value '_OTHER_'

methods.name: activate
methods.description: Enables and makes visible the given input field, and sets focus on it

methods.name: process_choice
methods.description: Activates an input text field if the 'Other' option is selected; otherwise disables and hides it

methods.name: check_choice
methods.description: Verifies that the user has selected the 'Other' option; if not, prompts the user with an alert
